messages:
Aisha: Noticing a p95 uptick on tiny requests after yesterday's selector tweak. Dash: https://dash.redwood/hosts/tiny-p95 :eyes:
Tom: saw it. Any change in batch hist or kvcache?
Aisha: running-batch median down 4 -> 2. KV remote-fallbacks + smallwrite count up.
Li: sample trace (trimmed):
```
10:22:01.100 parse 0.7ms
10:22:01.101 tokenize 2.9ms
10:22:01.104 kvcache 0.6ms (miss->fetch 4.4ms)
10:22:01.109 kernel 21.0ms
10:22:01.132 grpc_writev 4.5ms (3 frames)
```
Tom: Kernel-selector likely chose the fused kernel that favors long seq throughput. For tiny seqs it's heavier -> lower concurrency -> smaller batch -> kv hot-shard thrash -> remote fetches -> more smallwrites. Feedback loop.
Aisha: Mitigation: infra-bot can soft-rollback the selector on canary. Also add selector gate: if running_batch_p50 <3 prefer lightweight kernel.
infra-bot: Soft-rollback requested. Starting now.
deploy-bot: Soft-rollback started at 10:26:30 UTC.
Li: Longer term: include host-side preproc+network cost into kernel scoring and emit per-host metrics: kernel_variant, running_batch_hist, kvcache_remote_rate, smallwrite_count. Also add a 2k tiny-request replay to preflight for selector changes.
Aisha: Agree. Rolling follow-ups into an RFC and CI micro-benchmark. infra-bot: rollback complete, metrics trending back. Closing alert for now. :thumbsup:
